arStrings.szText: Gain {c_number}{SF_10}{/c} Fury each time {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} deals direct damage to an enemy, or {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} Fury against Elite enemies.
{c_important}Whirlwind{/c} also creates {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} {c_important}{u}Dust Devils{/u}{/c} that each deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_DUSTDEVIL_DMG_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Whirlwind{/c} also explodes, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEB_EXPLOSION_TOOLTIP}{/c} Fire damage and inflicting {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEB_FIRE_DOT}{/c} Burning damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADEB_FIRE_DOT}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Whirlwind{/c} now deals Fire damage.

Attacking with another Skill grants {c_number}{SF_27}{/c} stacks of charge up to {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} that decays over time. Your {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and gains {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|x%|]{/c} Movement Speed per stack.

While {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} has charges it launches {c_important}{u}Iron Shrapnel{/u}{/c} at Nearby enemies, each dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_SHRAPNEL_DMG_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage and inflicting {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEC_SHRAPNEL_BLEED_TOOLTIP}{/c} Bleeding damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADEC_SHRAPNEL_BLEED_TOOLTIP}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Whirlwind{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_37}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage and costs {c_number}{SF_36}{/c} additional Fury.
Channeling {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} causes it to deal {c_number}[{SF_46}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage each time it hits an enemy, stacking up to {c_number}{SF_49}{/c} times.
Critical Strikes from {c_important}Whirlwind{/c} {c_important}{u}Weaken{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}{SF_48}{/c} seconds.
